2014_spell_mechanics.green-flame-blade.s: At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 fire damage on a hit, and the fire damage increases to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. At 11th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8 and the fire damage increases to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. At 17th level, the extra damage increases to 3d8 and the fire damage increases to 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
